pages.title: Finding a church
pages.text: Search new terrain near Overworld villages (within 50 blocks of the village boundary), or explore the $(l:white_space_dimension)Great White Space$(). Churches are rare in both and do not appear retroactively.

pages.title: Structure search
pages.text: Use /locate structure in the correct dimension, followed by its ID.$(br2)Overworld: tinkersnewlife:sleepwake_church$(br2)White Space: tinkersnewlife:sleepwake_church_white_space

pages.title: Inside the church
pages.text: Four hidden chests hold relic or Tinkers' materials. Look in the carvings and roof for a netherite block and seven Gheloth ore blocks. Resident Momo stays and refreshes stock daily. Even if hired, she will not attack $(l:momo_battle)Boss Momo$().
